summary_1line: Vidura warns Krishna that Duryodhana’s arrogance and reliance on powerful allies make peace impossible, but Krishna explains he must still attempt to prevent the coming war.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vidura speaks earnestly to Krishna in the quiet of the night chamber, warning him about Duryodhana’s pride and the looming war.
Krishna sits calmly in Vidura’s house after supper, listening thoughtfully as the wise counselor cautions him against entering the Kuru court.
Krishna, serene and resolute, explains that even if peace fails he must still try to save the earth from a terrible war.
